entries.031913aa73bb0051: The company undertakes construction contracts for detached houses using timber post-and-beam and 2×6 construction methods, and sells built-for-sale houses. Consolidated subsidiary Taisei Jutaku Co., Ltd. and others handle this business in the Tokyo metropolitan area.
entries.3d73b77310a8a1a7: Centered on the Kinki and Tokyo metropolitan areas, and in recent years also expanding into regional core cities, the company earns rental income by holding developed or acquired rental properties over the long term. The company decides whether to hold or sell properties according to market conditions and interest rate trends.
entries.3f9cdec1f3991b62: A real estate development company based in Wakayama and Osaka, handling everything from land acquisition to development, sales and leasing.
entries.5a3a2f61cb876534: Real estate development and leasing business
entries.69af512edb40dcca: A reportable segment that develops and acquires rental properties and leases them. The basic approach is diversified investment not concentrated on any particular use, such as shared housing, commercial facilities, office buildings and parking lots, with rental income as the main source of revenue. The company also handles subleasing, in which it leases land from multiple landowners and subleases it as a single consolidated plot to tenant companies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,273 million.
entries.73efa91a68dd7395: This is a reportable segment that develops and sells residential land and develops and sells industrial land for corporate customers. It also undertakes construction contracts for detached houses, sells built-for-sale houses, and builds stores to tenants’ orders. Net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥8,288 million.
entries.77359cad1b5b72d5: A reportable segment that plans, develops and sells condominiums for sale. The company operates its own brands “Unihaim” and “Unihaim Exia” and the urban compact condominium brand “Aura”, and also manages condominiums. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,770 million.
